tools.title: Select Tab
tools.description: Switch to an open Dia tab
tools.instructions: Switches to an open Dia tab and brings Dia to the front.

tabId.description: The ID of the tab, when known from a previous tool result.

query.description:
Text matched against tab titles and URLs (case-insensitive), e.g. "github" or "Hacker News".

@remarks Ignored when tabId is provided. Omit both tabId and query to target the focused tab.

tools.name: close-tab
tools.title: Close Tab
tools.description: Close an open Dia tab by its ID
tools.instructions:
Closes the Dia tab with the given tabId.

Without a tabId, nothing is closed: the tool resolves the tab from the query (or the focused tab) and returns it,
so it can be confirmed and closed by calling this tool again with its tabId.

tabId.description: The ID of the tab, when known from a previous tool result.

query.description:
Text matched against tab titles and URLs (case-insensitive), e.g. "github" or "Hacker News".

@remarks Ignored when tabId is provided. Omit both tabId and query to target the focused tab.

tools.name: get-tab-contents
tools.title: Get Tab Contents
tools.description: Return the visible text of a Dia tab or the focused tab
tools.instructions:
Returns the visible text of a Dia tab, or of the focused tab when no tab is specified.
Use it to read, summarize or answer questions about a page.

tabId.description: The ID of the tab, when known from a previous tool result.

query.description:
Text matched against tab titles and URLs (case-insensitive), e.g. "github" or "Hacker News".

@remarks Ignored when tabId is provided. Omit both tabId and query to target the focused tab.

tools.name: get-tabs
tools.title: Get Tabs
tools.description: Return the open tabs across all Dia windows
tools.instructions:
Returns the open tabs across all Dia windows, including pinned tabs.
Each tab has its window ID, tab ID, title, URL, and whether it is pinned or focused.

query.description:
Text to filter tabs by title or URL (case-insensitive).

@remarks Omit it to return every open tab.

tools.name: get-focused-tab
tools.title: Get Focused Tab
tools.description: Return the tab currently focused in Dia
tools.instructions: Returns the tab the user is currently viewing in Dia: its window ID, tab ID, title and URL.

tools.name: search-history
tools.title: Search History
tools.instructions: Searches the Dia browsing history of the active profile, most recent visits first.

searchText.description:
Words to search for in page titles and URLs. Every word must match.

@remarks Omit it to return the most recently visited pages.

tools.name: search-bookmarks
tools.title: Search Bookmarks
tools.instructions: Searches the Dia bookmarks of the active profile and returns each match with its folder.

searchText.description:
Words to search for in bookmark names and URLs. Every word must match; prefix a word with "-" to exclude it.

@remarks Omit it to list bookmarks.

ai.instructions:
# dia-ai-actions
Dia is a web browser by The Browser Company. Use open-url to open a page or run a web search in a new tab; pass the user's words as the url when they ask to search for something.
To switch to a tab, pass a short query that matches its title or URL (e.g. "github"), or no target at all when the user means the current tab. If the tool reports several matching tabs, ask the user which one they mean and retry with its tabId.
close-tab only closes a tab given its tabId. If the get-tabs tool is available, take the tabId from it. Otherwise call close-tab with a query (or no target for the current tab): it closes nothing and returns a candidate, then call close-tab again with that candidate's tabId. Never tell the user a tab was closed unless close-tab returned closed: true.
If a tool reports that Raycast needs permission to control Dia, relay its System Settings instructions instead of retrying or claiming the action succeeded.
# dia-ai-tab-contents
Use get-tab-contents to read a page before summarizing it or answering questions about it. Always call it for questions about a page's contents, even after get-focused-tab or get-tabs; never answer from a tab's title or URL alone. Call it without a target for "this page" or "the current tab", or pass a short query matching the tab's title or URL.
If it reports that Dia must allow JavaScript from AppleScript, tell the user how to relaunch Dia instead of guessing the page contents. If it reports that Raycast needs permission to control Dia, relay its System Settings instructions instead of retrying. If it reports that the page has no readable text, tell the user the page has no readable text and don't describe or guess its contents. If it reports a Dia internal page, tell the user it's a Dia internal page that can't be read, without guessing its contents. If it reports that it couldn't read this tab for another reason, you may retry once; if it fails again, tell the user you couldn't read this tab and share the error, without guessing its contents. If the text is truncated, say that the answer is based on the beginning of the page.
# dia-ai-read
Use get-focused-tab when the user refers to "this tab", "the current tab" or "the page I'm on", and get-tabs for questions about open tabs.
Use search-history for pages the user visited before and search-bookmarks for saved bookmarks. Only pass searchText when the user names something to look for, and keep it to the essential keywords.
Never show tab or window IDs to the user unless they ask for them.
If get-tabs or get-focused-tab reports that Raycast needs permission to control Dia, relay its System Settings instructions instead of retrying or saying there are no tabs.
